Specification: This module is a very small TLA+ specification containing a theorem about a constant element y and a constant E. It does not model a transition system, algorithm, or fault-tolerant protocol; instead, it states a simple logical property that y is a member of the singleton set {y} and that E equals 42. The file has no variables, no actions, no temporal specification, no fairness assumptions, and no proof script.
